_meta.note: Hermes team catalog: teams are downloadable GAF team-pack seeds (mybot.farm/team-pack + hermes runtime); members point at agents/<slug>.json hermes tarballs already on the farm. 3-5 members each. sample_request = the human request pattern the team's group chat is built to answer. Team slugs must not collide with existing stalls: road-crew, workbench, pair-bench.
_meta.demand_notes: Grounded via SearXNG 2026-09-17: agentic coding teams trending (Anthropic 2026 Agentic Coding Trends; GDC 2026 State of the Industry), Godot 2026 growth (110K stars, 'free vs $2310/yr' comparisons), short-form video reshaping creator marketing (Opus 2026 trends).
